title: Reduce disjoint verifier peak traced allocation by 62% (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Tooling improvement with a scoped serialization-equivalence proof. An opt-in streaming encoder reduces peak traced allocation during complete `DisjointTensor(26).verify()` from **107,703,062 to 41,079,356 bytes**, about **62%**, with identical bytes, checks and complete receipts. This answers Wentao Li's PR #2117 Open next question 1. No new κ or supplier admission is claimed.

```diff
 unchanged support, topology, recurrence and physical embedding checks
- materialize every DAG row, complete JSON document and encoded bytes
+ hash the identical compact JSON bytes in bounded chunks
 unchanged complete receipt
```

Adds only `research/disjoint-dag-streaming/`. The original checker, historical certificates and selected frontier remain unchanged. Credit Douglas Colkitt, Wentao Li #2001/#2117, Stephan Arrington #1044 and the retained checker lineage. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19242010). Scientific base `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, priority revision 8. Published head `e4eb97178bdc083cf9e60f8796cf93cddbe27dbf`.

## Evidence

- **Before:** whole-document serialization peaks at 84,685,162 traced bytes; complete verification peaks at 107,703,062 bytes.
  **After:** serialization peaks at 691,046 bytes; complete verification peaks at 41,079,356 bytes. All five measurements per side give these peaks.
- Five interleaved fresh-process pairs on CPython 3.12.15/macOS arm64, zero errors, identical complete receipts. Construction plus verification median is 0.399820 s [0.397821, 0.433130] versus 0.377585 s [0.371520, 0.388686]. This is descriptive timing, not a portable speed guarantee. Allocations are measured after circuit construction with `tracemalloc`, separately from timing; they are not process RSS.
- Exact bytes on 1,623 schema fixtures and six complete circuits through `h=26`; 41 rejecting controls. The complete nondigest checker AST is unchanged. Both registered normal and optimized modes pass; direct runs take about 1.29 s and 1.25 s.
- Exact committed bytes, source history and modes pass for 13 files. The official export passes integrity and declared-input coverage. Read-only Git-free normal and optimized export checks pass without changed bytes.

Reproduce from the repository root with the tested interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/disjoint-dag-streaming
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/disjoint-dag-streaming/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/disjoint-dag-streaming/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/disjoint-dag-streaming --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected scientific output: `PASS_DISJOINT_DAG_STREAMING`; the registered runner also prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The benchmark and all five timing pairs are documented in README.md. With an existing external output directory assigned to `disjoint_run_dir`, its exact reproduction is:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/disjoint-dag-streaming/benchmark.py --rounds 5 --output "$disjoint_run_dir/measurements.json"
```

## Limitations

This is an opt-in historical-checker improvement, bounded to one million array entries and 10,000-bit supports. It proves byte equivalence for the stated schema, not correctness of every possible upstream circuit or a complete multiplication theorem. The unchanged compiler allocation remains. Default adoption and source-pin migration are not implemented. Full historical/selected supplier replays, native pricing, all-size compiler, precision/tape, erasure and exact recovery are unrun obligations. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Adopt the encoder in the default checker with an explicit migration that preserves historical source bindings.
2. Reduce the remaining compiler allocation while preserving every physical embedding and freshness check.

README.md and TASK.json give the first steps and blockers.

## Related open work

Final overlap refresh checked this account's open PRs created since the [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19242010) at 2026-10-28T12:55:34Z. None of the 13 other open PRs studies `DisjointTensor` DAG serialization or computes this allocation quantity, so no numerical comparison is needed. The earlier refreshed open-PR, Discussion and main searches likewise found no competing serialization contribution. PR #6112 optimizes the selected Clifford replay and PR #6087 optimizes replay planning; their engines and inputs are separate. PR #6050 addresses the shared navigation failures below. No predecessor numbers were independently audited for this contribution.

## CI notes

**Uncertified by CI** at published commit `e4eb97178bdc083cf9e60f8796cf93cddbe27dbf`. In [run 40694782522](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40694782522), `plan` failed and the package replay was skipped. **The package replay did not run in CI. A maintainer must re-run CI after main's documentation is fixed.** Local validation above remains local evidence only.

The failure is not caused by this change. Base main commit `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, whose subject ends in `[skip ci]`, admitted PR6030 and updated the selected record without matching the current-status and CI navigation documentation. The two onboarding failures are:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record` expects `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`; the existing bold span also includes ` = 781451/250000000`.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` expects `make frontier6030-verify` in `docs/ci-verification.md`, the file read by that test; its current section still describes #5599 and `make frontier5599-verify`.

The failed onboarding job reports 678 tests, exactly these two failures and 23 skips. The same two failures were checked in [PR #6120's run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027). They were also reproduced locally before publication. Existing PR #6050 addresses the documentation mismatch. No code was pushed or main documentation changed in response to this CI result.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. The adapter is opt-in and can be removed independently.

**Blast Radius:** isolated. Only the new research package and its declared replay are added.
